user.title: Halo Collar
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use in the Halo mobile app. This integration is telemetry-only by default and unofficial. The advanced OAuth client fields can be left at their defaults.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Halo Collar
reauth_confirm.description: Your Halo session expired or your password changed. Sign in with the same saved Halo account. To use a different account, add a separate Halo Collar integration.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Halo service. Please try again.
error.account_mismatch: Use the email saved for this integration. To use a different Halo account, add a separate integration.

abort.already_configured: This Halo account is already configured.
abort.reauth_account_unavailable: The saved account is missing or inconsistent, or this integration was removed. No credentials were changed. See the [account recovery guide]({recovery_url}) before removing or adding an integration.
abort.reauth_entry_changed: The saved account or OAuth settings changed during sign-in, or this integration was removed. No sign-in credentials were saved. Restart reauthentication from the current integration. See the [account recovery guide]({recovery_url}) if the problem continues.

data.allow_fence_disable: Allow fences to be disabled (requires fence controls)

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the Halo cloud for new telemetry. Between 60 and 3600 seconds; the collar itself typically reports every few minutes.
data_description.stale_after: Report age after which Connectivity turns off. This reflects the last collar report, not a live connection check. Polling the cloud does not force a collar report. Between 120 and 86400 seconds. Controls always require reports no older than 900 seconds, or this limit if shorter.
data_description.enable_fence_controls: Adds an idempotent Enable fences button. Controls remain unavailable when collar telemetry is stale.
data_description.enable_find_collar: Adds a manual sound and light button. It may confuse a pet wearing the collar. The command is blocked on stale/ambiguous state, active or unknown walks, missing subscription entitlement, and a post-dispatch cooldown; ambiguous outcomes are never retried.
data_description.allow_fence_disable: Also adds a Fence mode switch that can disable containment. This remains off unless fail-safe fence controls are enabled, requires a separate high-risk opt-in, and is blocked during an active walk.
data_description.enable_recall_whistle: Beta. Adds a Recall whistle button and status sensor for each dog. The button plays the dog's trained Recall whistle and nothing else; this integration cannot send corrections. Turning it on first asks you to register Home Assistant with Halo, a permanent change to your Halo account. Each press rereads Halo and is blocked on stale or ambiguous state, active or unknown walks, collars without numbered commands, and a 60-second cooldown. Commands expire within 30 seconds and are never retried. Success means Halo accepted the command, not that the collar played it.

recall_registration.title: Register Home Assistant with Halo
recall_registration.description: Halo plays the Recall whistle only for a registered mobile device. Confirming sends one request through Halo's unofficial private API that adds Home Assistant to your Halo account as a device. Halo offers no way to remove it, and removing this integration does not remove it. If Halo's answer is lost, the integration never sends another registration; follow the Recall whistle recovery steps in the README.

data.confirm_recall_registration: Register Home Assistant as a device on my Halo account

error.registration_not_confirmed: Check the box to register Home Assistant, or go back and leave the Recall whistle off.
error.integration_not_loaded: Halo Collar must be loaded to register. Fix setup, then try again.
error.registration_failed: No registration request reached Halo, so nothing changed on your account. Try again later.
error.registration_uncertain: Halo's answer to the registration was lost, so the Recall whistle stays off and no other registration will be sent. See the Recall whistle recovery steps in the README.
error.recall_storage_unavailable: Saved Recall whistle state could not be read, so no registration was sent. Restart Home Assistant and try again.
